doc: Traceability for GOAL-46 fault injection, GOAL-47 soak, and the rejection-probe dispositions. `measured` faults are injected by the named repo-owned workflow probe on both lanes and compared as v2 evidence or asserted per lane fail-closed; `runner-internal` faults cannot be injected from a GitHub Actions workflow on either lane (the runner host is not reachable from a job) and name the velnor-side owner that must prove them. scripts/test_audits.py locks this catalogue against drift.

app-token-probe.yml.reason: Secret-gated by design: without VELNOR_APP_ID/VELNOR_APP_PRIVATE_KEY it emits not-ready evidence, never a pass; automatic runs would assert nothing.

attestation-negative.yml.reason: Probe jobs lack job-level continue-on-error, so runs conclude red by design even when assert-negative holds; automatic wiring needs generator-side rework to the l2-negative green-run shape. Generated file: cannot fix from this repo while regen is blocked.

l2-negative.yml.reason: Main-head gate (admit-default-head) forbids PR execution by design; fleet admission is asserted on main pushes and the Sunday schedule via rejection-schedule.yml.

soak.note: Runner-process memory/fds/threads and host disk/journal are not observable from a job step; those signals stay velnor-side (velnor-bench soak). The fixture soak asserts the workflow-observable half: zero residue per round, bounded workspace growth, bounded latency drift, repeated warm builds and checkouts. Random cancellation is deliberately deterministic here (fault-suite cancel-race); periodic daemon restart and GC are runner-internal.
signals: owned docker objects per round (label-censused, must be zero)
workspace bytes first/last per round (growth bucket)
